verdict.rationale: Amplitude ships AI features (plain-language AI answers and an embeddable agent), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Amplitude's own MCP server, which exposes Amplitude data to external AI tools; that is the server role and is not credited here. Nothing shows Amplitude connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools, and the integrations directory covers data and marketing connectors, not MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
